link.description: Your personal link automatically connects new members to your profile.

locked.title: Partner program is locked
locked.text: Get your first card (a gift or a purchased one) to unlock your referral link and partner stats.

REVENUE.title: Unclaimed partner rewards
REVENUE.full: Every day you receive a commission from the nominal value of active nodes purchased by partners who joined via your link. The rate depends on the node series. Press «Claim reward» to move the accumulated sats to your balance.

LINK.title: Your referral link
LINK.full: Everyone who opens the app via your link is linked to your profile. Share it in chats and posts and help new members get started.

TOTAL_REG.title: Total sign-ups
TOTAL_REG.full: The number of users who joined via your link.

INVESTORS.title: Investors
INVESTORS.full: Partners who have bought at least one node. Gift cards don't count.

NON_INVEST.title: Not invested yet
NON_INVEST.full: Partners who joined via your link but haven't bought a node yet. Tell them how the platform works.

PARTNER_CAPITAL.title: Partners' capital
PARTNER_CAPITAL.full: The total purchase price of your partners' currently active (purchased) nodes. Your commission is calculated from these nodes.

NOT_ACTIVATED.label: Not activated
NOT_ACTIVATED.description: The partner hasn't activated the welcome coin yet. Help them get started.

WAITING.label: Testing · {{count}} d left
WAITING.description: The partner is testing the platform with the gift coin.

INVEST.label: Time to invest
INVEST.description: The test period is over. The partner hasn't bought a node yet.

GROW.label: Time to grow
GROW.description: The partner has free funds and no active purchased nodes.

WORKING.label: Nodes are working
WORKING.description: An active participant — their purchased nodes are mining.

UNKNOWN.label: Exploring
UNKNOWN.description: The partner is exploring the platform.

detail.writeHint: The selected message is copied automatically
detail.noUsername: This partner has no public Telegram username, so a chat can't be opened. The message has been copied.
detail.copied: Message copied — paste it into the chat

NOT_ACTIVATED.CARE: Hi, {{name}}! I noticed you haven't activated your gift coin yet. Want me to help you set it up and show how everything works?
NOT_ACTIVATED.FRIENDLY: Hi! Your Tyrex Mini gift is waiting in the app. Activate it and take a look around — it only takes a minute.
NOT_ACTIVATED.HUMOR: Your gift coin is getting bored without you :) Open the app and press «Get»!

WAITING.CARE: Hi, {{name}}! Your test coin is running. Use this time to look at how the nodes work — I'm happy to answer any questions.
WAITING.FRIENDLY: How's it going? I see the test coin is running. Ping me if anything is unclear.
WAITING.HUMOR: Your test coin is busy working :) Check the analytics screen when you have a minute!

INVEST.CARE: Hi, {{name}}! The test period is over. If you'd like to continue, I can walk you through the node series and their terms so you can decide for yourself.
INVEST.FRIENDLY: The test drive is done! Want me to explain how the different nodes differ? No pressure — just so you have the full picture.
INVEST.HUMOR: Test drive complete :) If you're curious about the next level, I'll gladly explain the details.

GROW.CARE: Hi, {{name}}! I see you have funds on your balance. If you have questions about the nodes or withdrawals — just ask.
GROW.FRIENDLY: Hi! If you're thinking about what to do with your balance, I can explain the options. Remember the risks of crypto, though.
GROW.HUMOR: Your balance is on vacation :) Want to chat about your options?

WORKING.CARE: Hi, {{name}}! Glad to see your nodes running. Keep an eye on your accruals, and message me if anything comes up.
WORKING.FRIENDLY: Hi! Your nodes are running — great. Let me know if you have any questions.
WORKING.HUMOR: Your nodes are working while we chat :) Have a great day!

UNKNOWN.CARE: Hi, {{name}}! How are you finding the app? I'm happy to help if you have any questions.
UNKNOWN.FRIENDLY: Hi! Just checking in — let me know if you need help with anything in Tyrex.
UNKNOWN.HUMOR: Hi! Just checking you haven't got lost in the app :) Need a hand?
